y-m-41-01.title: Ingabe umthetho othi 'uma umkhiqizo ungu-0, isici esisodwa singu-0' ungasetshenziswa nakuma-matrix?
y-m-41-01.topic: Lapho umkhiqizo wama-matrix amabili angewona ama-zero matrix uba yi-zero matrix
y-m-41-01.goal: Nquma ngesibonelo esiphikisayo ukuthi umthetho othi 'uma umkhiqizo ungu-0, isici esisodwa singu-0', owawubambe ezinombolweni, nawo ubamba kuma-matrix yini, bese ucabanga ukuthi isiphetho sishintsha kanjani lapho ushintshela ku-matrix ehlukile.
y-m-41-01.material: Kunombolo zangempela a, b, uma ab=0 khona a=0 noma b=0. UJian ucabange ukuthi lo mthetho ungasetshenziswa nakuma-matrix futhi wathi: "Uma AB=O futhi A ayiyona i-zero matrix, khona B iyi-zero matrix." Lapha O i-zero matrix engu-2×2 enawo wonke ama-entry angu-0. A i-matrix engu-2×2 enomugqa wokuqala (1, 2) nomugqa wesibili (2, 4), futhi B i-matrix engu-2×2 enomugqa wokuqala (p, q) nomugqa wesibili (r, s). Wonke ama-entry ayizinombolo eziphelele.
y-m-41-01.thinking.0: Nquma ukuthi umthetho wezinombolo ungadluliselwa kuma-matrix njengoba unjalo yini
y-m-41-01.thinking.1: Yenza isibonelo esiphikisayo esanelisa isimo ngqo
y-m-41-01.thinking.2: Hlukanisa ama-matrix lapho kuvela isibonelo esiphikisayo nalawo lapho singavezi
y-m-41-01.prereq.0: Ilebula ye-H1 iwuhlobo lobunzima nolwesekelo kuphela lwalo msebenzi wokukhiqiza, hhayi ibanga elimiswe uhlelo lokufunda. Kucatshangwa abafundi osebevele bafunde ama-matrix ezingeni lokwethula lesikole esiphakeme.
y-m-41-01.prereq.1: Ungabala umkhiqizo wama-matrix angu-2×2 usebenzisa ama-entry
y-m-41-01.prereq.2: Yazi incazelo ye-inverse matrix (i-matrix enikeza i-identity matrix E uma iphindaphindwa)
y-m-41-01.s.s1.prompt: Ufuna ukuthola ukuthi isimangalo sikaJian silungile yini. Yisiphi isinyathelo sokuqala esifaneleke kakhulu?
y-m-41-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala emshweni ukuthi udinga ukuba nohlobo luni lwe-B eyodwa kuphela ukuze uphule isimangalo.
y-m-41-01.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala i-entry eyodwa ye-AB usebenzisa p, q, r, s, bese uthola icala elilodwa lapho iba ngu-0.
y-m-41-01.s.s1.o.a: Njengoba A ingeyona i-zero matrix, yamukela ukuthi B iyi-zero matrix, njengasezinombolweni
y-m-41-01.s.s1.r.a: Udlulisele umthetho osetshenziselwa izinombolo kuma-matrix njengoba unjalo. Bhala phansi ngqo ukuthi yini okumele ibambe ezambeni zemikhiqizo yama-entry ukuze umkhiqizo ube ngu-O.
y-m-41-01.s.s1.o.b: Awukwazi ukwenza noma yisiphi isinqumo ngaphambi kokwazi wonke ama-entry e-B
y-m-41-01.s.s1.r.b: Noma ngaphandle kokunquma i-B, ungakwazi ukunquma uma kukhona i-B eyodwa kuphela ephula isimangalo. Khumbula ukuthi 'isimangalo ngazo zonke B' sihlolwa kanjani.
y-m-41-01.s.s1.o.c: Hlola ukuthi phakathi kwe-B ezingezona ama-zero matrix, ikhona yini enayo AB=O
y-m-41-01.s.s1.r.c: Ubone ukuthi isimangalo sikhuluma nge-'zonke B' futhi wamisa isiqondiso sakho ekutholeni isibonelo esifanelana nesimo.
y-m-41-01.s.s1.o.d: Njengoba ama-entry e-A engenazo izinombolo ezingu-negethivu, ama-entry e-AB awakwazi ukuba ngu-0
y-m-41-01.s.s1.r.d: Noma i-A ingenazo izinombolo ezingu-negethivu, uma ama-entry e-B angu-negethivu, isamba semikhiqizo singaba ngu-0. Cabanga kabanzi ngamanani angenzeka e-B.
y-m-41-01.s.s1.explain: Isimangalo esithi 'sibamba kuzo zonke B' siphulwa yi-B eyodwa enelisa isimo kuyilapho isiphetho singalungile. Ngakho ukuthola nokuhlola i-B engeyona i-zero matrix ene-AB=O kuyisinyathelo sokuqala esifanelekile.
y-m-41-01.s.s2.prompt: Yenza ama-B amabili ahlukene angewona ama-zero matrix ane-AB=O. Ama-entry p, q, r, s ayizinombolo eziphelele kusuka ku-−9 kuya ku-9.
y-m-41-01.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ngqo ama-entry amane e-AB usebenzisa p, q, r, s, bese ubhala ukuthi yini edingekayo ukuze wonke abe ngu-0.
y-m-41-01.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi isimo esifanayo siyaphindeka phakathi kwamafomula owabhalile yini.
y-m-41-01.s.s2.fail.c2: B iyi-matrix ka-zero. Okungenani elilodwa lamanani kufanele lingabi ngu-0.
y-m-41-01.s.s2.explain: Umugqa wokuqala we-AB ngu-(p+2r, q+2s) futhi umugqa wesibili ngu-(2p+4r, 2q+4s). Umugqa wesibili uyizikhathi ezi-2 zomugqa wokuqala, ngakho uma p+2r=0 no-q+2s=0, khona-ke AB=O. Isibonelo, uma umugqa wokuqala we-B ungu-(2, 0) futhi owesibili ungu-(−1, 0), akukho kwa-A noma B okuyi-matrix ka-zero kodwa AB=O.
y-m-41-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha elilodwa lama-B owathole, ukhombise ukuthi wonke amanani e-AB angu-0, bese ubhala ukuthi ufunde ini mayelana nesitatimende sikaJian.
y-m-41-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Uma ubala kuphela umugqa 1, ikholomu 1 nomugqa 1, ikholomu 2 ye-AB, bheka ukuthi kwenzekani kwamanye amanani.
y-m-41-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Sebenzisa kokubili 'A ayiyona i-matrix ka-zero' no-'B ayiyona i-matrix ka-zero' bese uqeda isiphetho emshweni owodwa.
y-m-41-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Nge-B oyikhethile, ingabe ubale ngempela futhi wakhombisa ukuthi wonke amanani amane e-AB angu-0?
y-m-41-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ngokucacile ukuthi akukho kwa-A noma B okuyi-matrix ka-zero?
y-m-41-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ubhale wazi ukuthi isibonelo esisodwa sanele ukuphula isitatimende mayelana 'nawo wonke u-B'?
y-m-41-01.s.s2.because.model.0: Uma umugqa wokuqala we-B ungu-(2, 0) futhi owesibili ungu-(−1, 0), wonke amanani e-AB angu-0, ngakho AB=O. Akukho kwa-A noma B okuyi-matrix ka-zero kodwa umphumela uyi-matrix ka-zero, ngakho umthetho wezinombolo othi uma umphumela ungu-0, isici esisodwa singu-0 awusebenzi kuma-matrix.
y-m-41-01.s.s2.because.model.1: Uma uthatha p=0, q=2, r=0, s=−1, i-AB iyi-matrix ka-zero enamanani onke angu-0. Umphumela ungaba yi-matrix ka-zero noma ngabe akukho okuyi-matrix ka-zero, ngakho isitatimende sikaJian besiphutha.
y-m-41-01.s.s3.prompt: UJian wathi futhi, "Lokho kungoba imigqa emibili ye-A iyizikhathi eziningi komunye nomunye." Uma usebenzisa i-A′ (umugqa wokuqala (1, 2), owesibili (3, 4)) esikhundleni se-A, ingabe A′B=O ingenzeka ku-B engeyona i-matrix ka-zero? (I-A′ inayo i-matrix ephambene. Lokhu kungoba 1×4−2×3=−2 akuyona u-0.)
y-m-41-01.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi kuzoshintsha ini uma uphindaphinda izinhlangothi zombili zesibalo A′B=O nge-matrix ehlobene no-A′.
y-m-41-01.s.s3.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi umehluko phakathi kuka-A no-A′ (ukuthi kukhona i-matrix ephambene yini) uthinta kanjani ukuthola u-B ene-AB=O.
y-m-41-01.s.s3.o.a: Ayikwazi ukwenzeka. Ukuphindaphinda izinhlangothi zombili ze-A′B=O nge-matrix ephambene ye-A′ kunika B=O
y-m-41-01.s.s3.r.a: Uhlulele isimo esinombandela oshintshiwe usebenzisa isici esisha se-A′ (inayo i-matrix ephambene).
y-m-41-01.s.s3.o.b: Ingenzeka. Umphumela wama-matrix amabili angewona ama-matrix ka-zero ungaba yi-O kunoma yiliphi icala
y-m-41-01.s.s3.r.b: Welule isiphetho sesibonelo sangaphambilini kuwo wonke u-A. Bheka futhi ukuthi yisiphi isici sika-A esasetshenziswa kuleso sibonelo.
y-m-41-01.s.s3.o.c: Ngihlole ama-B ambalwa futhi akukho okubukeka kunika u-O, ngakho ayikwazi ukwenzeka
y-m-41-01.s.s3.r.c: Ukuhlola kwandisa ukuzethemba, kodwa akuhloli wonke u-B. Cabanga ukuthi kukhona yini indlela yokucabanga ngawo wonke u-B ngesikhathi esisodwa.
y-m-41-01.s.s3.o.d: Ingenzeka. Amanani e-A′ makhulu kuneka-A, ngakho kunendawo eningi yokuthi umphumela ube ngu-0
y-m-41-01.s.s3.r.d: Usayizi wamanani akuyona indinganiso yokuhlulela. Bala ukuthi iqiniso lokuthi kukhona i-matrix ephambene lixhumana kanjani nesibalo AB=O.
y-m-41-01.s.s3.explain: Uma i-A′ inayo i-matrix ephambene, ungaphindaphinda izinhlangothi zombili ze-A′B=O ngaleyo phambene ukuthola B=O. Ngakho u-B ongeyona i-matrix ka-zero akakwazi ukufeza A′B=O. U-A wangaphambilini wayengenayo i-matrix ephambene, ngakho lesi siphetho asizange silandele.
y-m-41-01.s.s3.acc.0: Ukuhlola ama-B amaningana nokwandisa ukuzethemba kwakho kuyisiqalo esifanele. Kodwa awukwazi ukuhlola wonke u-B, ngakho ukucabanga ngawo wonke u-B ngesikhathi esisodwa ngesici njenge-matrix ephambene kuqinisekile kakhulu.

y-m-41-07.title: Uma sisikwela inombolo ngayinye, ingabe iba isikwele se-matrix?
y-m-41-07.topic: Ukuthola izimo lapho umcabango oyiphutha wokubala isikwele se-matrix ngokusikwela izinombolo ugcina khona
y-m-41-07.goal: Thola ama-matrix lapho umcabango oyiphutha othi 'isikwele se-matrix yinombolo ngayinye isikwelwe ngokwehlukana' ugcina khona, sebenza umbandela, bese wahlulela nokuthi lobu bubanzi abudluliswa emandleni ngokujwayelekile.
y-m-41-07.material: UMinseo uthe, "Isikwele se-matrix A silingana ne-matrix enenombolo ngayinye isikwelwe ngokwehlukana." A i-matrix engu-2×2 umugqa wayo wokuqala ungu-(a, b) futhi owesibili ungu-(c, d), futhi biza i-matrix enenombolo ngayinye isikwelwe ngokwehlukana ngo-A* (umugqa wokuqala (a², b²), umugqa wesibili (c², d²), kufundwa 'a squared'). A² umphumela we-matrix A×A. Isibonelo, uma umugqa wokuqala ka-A ungu-(1, 2) futhi owesibili ungu-(3, 4), A² unomugqa wokuqala (7, 10) nomugqa wesibili (15, 22), futhi A* unomugqa wokuqala (1, 4) nomugqa wesibili (9, 16). Zonke izinombolo ziyizinombolo eziphelele.
y-m-41-07.thinking.0: Thola izimo lapho umcabango oyiphutha ugcina khona ngokusebenza ngezinhlamvu
y-m-41-07.thinking.2: Hlola ukuthi impahla eyagcina kanye iyagcina nasemandleni alandelayo yini
y-m-41-07.s.s1.prompt: Esibonelweni esingenhla, A² no-A* bahlukile. Khona-ke yisiphi isinyathelo sokuqala esifaneleka kakhulu sokuthola ukuthi likhona yini i-matrix ene-A²=A*?
y-m-41-07.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala inombolo emugqeni 1, ekholomini 1 ye-A² ngqo ngokuka-a, b, c, bese uyiqhathanisa nenombolo endaweni efanayo ye-A*.
y-m-41-07.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala phansi ngamunye ukuthi yimuphi umbandela odingekayo ukwenza ifomula efanayo iphume ezindaweni zonke ezine.
y-m-41-07.s.s1.o.a: Njengoba bahlukile esibonelweni, nquma ukuthi azikho ama-matrix ane-A²=A*
y-m-41-07.s.s1.r.a: Ukuhluka ku-matrix eyodwa akusho ukuhluka kuwo wonke ama-matrix. Cabanga ngendlela yokuthola ukuthi likhona yini ama-matrix lapho belingana khona.
y-m-41-07.s.s1.o.b: Bhala izinombolo ezine ze-A² ngezinhlamvu bese uziqhathanisa nezinombolo ezindaweni ezifanayo ze-A*
y-m-41-07.s.s1.r.b: Misile umbandela ngefomula yezinhlamvu engasingatha zonke izimo ngesikhathi esisodwa, wedlula isibonelo.
y-m-41-07.s.s1.o.c: Nquma kusengaphambili ukuthi ugcina kuphela kuma-diagonal matrix (b no-c kokubili ngu-0), bese uhlola lokho kuphela
y-m-41-07.s.s1.r.c: Uncishise ububanzi kusengaphambili. Gcina kuvulekile ukuthi zikhona yini izimo lapho belingana khona ngisho nakuma-matrix angewona ama-diagonal, bese uhlola.
y-m-41-07.s.s1.o.d: Faka izinombolo ezahlukene ku-A bese ufuna izimo lapho A² no-A* belingana khona
y-m-41-07.s.s1.r.d: Ukuzama izinombolo ezahlukene nakho kuyindlela enhle yokuhlola. Ngemva kokuthola eyodwa, hlola ngezinhlamvu ukuthi kungani lowo mbandela uyadingeka.
y-m-41-07.s.s1.explain: Ukubhala izinombolo ezine ze-A² ngezinhlamvu kunika umugqa wokuqala (a²+bc, ab+bd) nomugqa wesibili (ca+dc, cb+d²). Ukuqhathanisa no-A* ezindaweni ezifanayo, imibandela ngu-bc=0, b(a+d)=b², c(a+d)=c². Ukuhlola ngokufaka izinombolo nakho kuhle, kodwa ifomula yezinhlamvu ikhombisa zonke izimo ngesikhathi esisodwa.
y-m-41-07.s.s1.acc.0: Ukuhlola ngokufaka izinombolo ezahlukene nakho kuyisiqalo esinengqondo. Kodwa ukuthi kungani isibonelo osithole sisebenza kumele kuhlolwe ngefomula yezinhlamvu.
y-m-41-07.s.s2.prompt: Yenza u-A ama-3 ahlukene ane-A²=A* angewona ama-diagonal matrix (okungenani u-b noma u-c akulona u-0). Izinombolo a, b, c, d ziyizinombolo eziphelele kusukela ku-−9 kuya ku-9.
y-m-41-07.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala izinombolo ezine ze-A² nezinombolo ezine ze-A* ngezinhlamvu, bese ubhala izibalo ezimisa izindawo ezifanayo zilingane.
y-m-41-07.s.s2.hint.1: Ukwenza u-bc alingane no-0, misa omunye ku-b no-c abe ngu-0, bese uthola amanani ahlangabezana nezibalo ezisele.
y-m-41-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Umugqa 1, ikholomu 1 nomugqa 2, ikholomu 2 ye-A² kulingana no-a² no-d².
y-m-41-07.s.s2.fail.c5: Iyi-diagonal matrix ene-b no-c kokubili ngu-0. Udinga ukuthola isibonelo esingesiyo i-diagonal matrix.
y-m-41-07.s.s2.explain: Imibandela ngu-bc=0, b(a+d)=b², c(a+d)=c². Uma b≠0 khona-ke c=0 no-a+d=b kumele kugcine, futhi uma c≠0 khona-ke b=0 no-a+d=c kumele kugcine. Isibonelo, ngomugqa wokuqala (1, 3) nomugqa wesibili (0, 2), A² unomugqa wokuqala (1, 9) nomugqa wesibili (0, 4), futhi A* ufana.
y-m-41-07.s.s2.because.prompt: Nge-A eyodwa oyithole, bala inombolo eyodwa ye-A² ngqo bese ukhombisa ukuthi ilingana nenombolo endaweni efanayo ye-A*, bese ubhala ukuthi uyithole kanjani le A.
y-m-41-07.s.s2.because.hint.0: Faka izinombolo ze-A oyikhethile emugqeni 1, ekholomini 2 ye-A² (noma enye inombolo), yibhale njengemiphumela nezamba, bese uyiqhathanisa nendawo efanayo ye-A*.
y-m-41-07.s.s2.because.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi uphinde umthetho ofanayo (yiliphi ilungu owalibeka ku-0) lapho wenza ama-A amaningana.
y-m-41-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ku-A owakhethile, usebenze ilungu elilodwa luka-A² ngokulibhala njengemikhiqizo nezamu?
y-m-41-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Uchaze ukuthi uhlolisise kanjani, njengokubeka oyedwa ka-b no-c ku-0 noma ukufanisa u-a+d?
y-m-41-07.s.s2.because.model.0: Uma umugqa wokuqala luka-A ungu-(1, 3) futhi umugqa wesibili ungu-(0, 2), umugqa 1, ikholomu 2 luka-A² ngu-1×3+3×2=9, futhi umugqa 1, ikholomu 2 luka-A* ngu-3²=9, olingana. Ngibeke u-c ku-0 futhi ngakhetha amanani ukuze u-a+d alingane no-b.
y-m-41-07.s.s2.because.model.1: Uma umugqa wokuqala luka-A ungu-(4, 0) futhi umugqa wesibili ungu-(5, 1), umugqa 2, ikholomu 1 luka-A² ngu-5×4+1×5=25, futhi umugqa 2, ikholomu 1 luka-A* ngu-5²=25. Ngibeke u-b ku-0 futhi ngakhetha amanani ukuze u-a+d alingane no-c.
y-m-41-07.s.s3.prompt: Phakathi kuka-A owawuthola, bheka u-A onomugqa wokuqala u-(1, 3) nomugqa wesibili u-(0, 2). U-A² walo A unomugqa wokuqala u-(1, 9) nomugqa wesibili u-(0, 4), olingana no-A*. Pho u-A³ (=A²×A) nomatriksi onelungu ngalinye elenziwe i-cube ngokuhlukile (umugqa 1, ikholomu 2 ngu-3³=27) nabo balingana? Hlulela ngokubala umugqa 1, ikholomu 2 luka-A³ ngqo.

y-m-41-07.s.s3.r.a: U-27 ngu-3³, hhayi ilungu luka-A³. Umugqa 1, ikholomu 2 luka-A³ kufanele ubalwe ngencazelo yomkhiqizo.

y-m-41-07.s.s3.r.b: Ukuze omatriksi balingane, amalungu ezindaweni zonke kumele alingane. Uma ngisho nendawo eyodwa ihlukile, abayona imatriksi efanayo.

y-m-41-07.s.s3.r.c: Isiphetho siyafana, kodwa u-18 inani lapho amagama athile ashodayo ekubaleni. Hlola ukuthi ungezile futhi umkhiqizo womugqa 1, ikholomu 1 luka-A² nomugqa 1, ikholomu 2 luka-A.

y-m-41-07.s.s3.r.d: Uhlolile ngokubala ngqo ukuthi isakhiwo esasisebenza ku-A² sisebenza yini ku-A³.
y-m-41-07.s.s3.explain: Umugqa 1, ikholomu 2 luka-A³=A²×A ngu-1×3+9×2=21. Umugqa 1, ikholomu 2 we-cube ngelungu ngalinye ngu-3³=27, ngakho omatriksi ababili bahlukile. Noma u-A²=A* usebenza, ungase ungasebenzi ku-A³, ngakho akumele ukholwe ukuthi isakhiwo siqhubeka sisebenza ngoba nje sasebenza kanye.
